rules.description: Rules are alternatives; a request matching any one of them is allowed.

hosts.description: Exact lowercase hostnames, or `*.` followed by a domain to match every subdomain of it (not the domain itself).

methods.description: HTTP methods the rule admits; omitted means any method.

paths.description: Path patterns the rule admits, as the proxy matches them; omitted means any path.

clusterInternal.description: Whether this rule's hosts are inside the cluster and meant to be. The proxy resolves every admitted host and refuses one that points at a private address, which is what stops an allowed name from reaching a Service, a Pod or a node — DNS rebinding included. Setting this lifts that refusal for this rule's hosts only, and never for loopback or link-local, which are the sandbox's own interfaces rather than the cluster.

credentialRef.description: The EgressCredential this rule lets a subject present, in the same namespace. The credential declares where it is substituted; this rule decides where it may go. A request that presents no placeholder is admitted by the rule and forwarded untouched.
